issues.on_page: Charges for services 460,625 (General Fund 437,440, of which Solid Waste dept 347,599 per p16)
issues.issue: About 75% of this line is solid waste (garbage) charges, which the user's 2026-10-28 rule puts in Utility Charges (incl. garbage/refuse). Under the more-than-half rule, Utility Charges, or a split, may fit better.

The departments schedule labels this 'In lieu' (In Lieu of Tax is its own category), but the fund statement (p5) and the budget schedule (p10) call the same 215,439 total 'Occupation'. Occupation is defensible, but the labels conflict.
Same 'In lieu' vs 'Occupation' label conflict as detail[3].

issues.on_page: Grants 502,024 (Water Fund, nonoperating); Capital Grants and Contributions on p3
issues.issue: This is a capital grant from an unnamed grantor, so it may be federal. Recording it in receipts is defensible because it is printed in nonoperating revenues.

The user's rule relabels capital outlay detail lines 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (e.g. Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways). This line, and the Keno and LB 840 capital outlay detail lines (p13), still carry the printed label. user_rules.py may fix this.
This is a noncurrent item, but the Accrued Liabilities category is for amounts due soon. 'other liabilities' or a debt category may fit better.
